source: npp1993 (Nathaniel Pavel, Modwerk maintainer), on their own unit; results as reported by the tester
statement: Hardware, OS 1.74: FZ78, the released core-ar2 0.3 with Filter Hz 1.2.1 alone, booted from RAM over USB on an Analog Rytm MKII on 2026-11-14, passed all four steps: with FRQ locked on a held trig at 440Hz, 1.11kHz, 2.22kHz and 21.1kHz the white box stayed the same width and covered the whole value; a locked RES showed its box as before; unlocked FRQ read 13.8Hz fully left and 21.1kHz fully right; about a minute of playback while turning FRQ had no freezes or dropouts.
scope: filter-hz 1.2.1 alone with the released core-ar2 0.3 (FZ78), booted from RAM in a scratch project.

builds.label: FZ78
builds.content: Modwerk's linker on stock 1.74: elekloader's released core-ar2 0.3 (6b97dfb3…3e58) + Filter Hz 1.2.1 from this folder (source c4ec14ab…), --version FZ78.
builds.loaded: RAM boot over USB from a flashed Modwerk base image with a RAM-boot gate; the flash was not written, and a power cycle returns to the flashed OS.

limitations: Tested by a maintainer, not by the module's author.
Booted from RAM, not flashed; the screen shows the flashed image's label.
Playback was not timed exactly (about a minute). Filter types other than LP2, other pages' locks and other modules beside it were not tried.
